stations.name: At sea (Strait of Belle Isle, for Liverpool)
stations.note: At sea (Strait of Belle Isle, for Liverpool): the edge of the map's water; the ship sails on beyond it (or comes in from beyond it).

trips.name: Canadian Pacific steamship
trips.note: R.M.S. Empress of Canada: sails Montreal 11.00 a.m. (Eastern standard time) Saturday July 3, Quebec that evening, out by the Strait of Belle Isle on Monday 5; due Liverpool July 10. Times after Montreal ESTIMATED (about 17 knots). Canadian Pacific Steamships, Montreal - Quebec - Liverpool, summer season 1948 (CP sailing list: Brendan, 15 Nov 2026). First class and tourist.
